The two supplied start URLs (the Nov 27, 2026 Penguins-Sabres stream page — which is unrelated to the Messi story — and the /athletic/ homepage) both returned HTTP 403 with only the text "nytimes.com Please enable JS and disable any ad blocker"; theathletic.com just redirected to the same 403 page.
